summary: Defensive economy civ built on Cisterns and Aqueducts. Olive Oil hires mercenaries from other civs, and Cataphracts and Greek Fire units make its Castle Age army strong.

spikes.label: Limitanei early
spikes.detail: Limitanei spearmen are available from the Dark Age and can form a shield wall.
spikes.answer: Don't fight them head on with melee; archers and cavalry raids on their villagers work better.

spikes.label: Mercenaries from Olive Oil
spikes.detail: From Feudal they can hire other civs' unique units with Olive Oil, so their army mix can surprise you.
spikes.answer: Scout the Mercenary House and adapt to what comes out of it.

spikes.label: Cataphracts and Greek Fire
spikes.detail: Cataphracts trample through infantry and Cheirosiphons spray Greek Fire. Their Castle Age army hits very hard.
spikes.answer: Spearmen in big numbers, crossbows and focus-firing the Cheirosiphons. Avoid clumping.
